blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Perpetual Help’s Mark Gojo Cruz redeemed himself on Friday, steering the Altas past San Sebastian, 82-75, in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament at San Juan Arena. After losing his cool in the overtime loss to Emilio Aguinaldo College last week, Gojo Cruz made sure to keep his composure this time to fuel the Altas to a 4-8 record in Group B. “I think that game gave me some added motivation because I was really hurt after that loss,” Gojo Cruz said, recalling his heated exchanges with the referees after their last game. “Had we won that game, we […]...
